parent.bilingualNote: Each practice question is shown and read in Arabic words (سبعة ضرب ثمانية), and your child answers in digits. It uses your recordings below when they're complete, otherwise the phone's Arabic voice if it has one; with neither, the words are still shown.
parent.voiceNote: Record the Arabic number words in your own voice, one short clip each. Bilingual mode plays them instead of the phone's voice. The clips are stored with your account and shared only with your children's phones.

parent.readAloudNote: Questions and steps are read out with the phone's own voice. If the phone has no voice installed, nothing is read and everything still works.
parent.paceNote: Measured against how fast your child types on their phone.
parent.missingNote: Like ? × 7 = 56, a first step into division. They start once facts are fluent, and don't change the fact map.

account.deleteNote: This deletes your account, every child on it, all their practice, linked phones and your voice recordings, straight away. It cannot be undone.
account.deleted: Your account and all its data have been deleted.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.intro: This app is a small family project. Here is exactly what it keeps, and why.
privacy.who: A parent built it for their own children and shares it with a few families by invitation. There are no ads, and nothing is sold.
privacy.stored: For parents: your email and a scrambled (hashed) password. For each child: the first name or nickname you enter, an optional birth year, the avatar, colour and settings, and their practice: each answer, how long it took, hints, lessons and the optional “how did that feel?” taps. For linked phones: the browser's short device description and when it was last used. If you record your voice: those clips.
privacy.notStored: Children have no accounts, emails or passwords. There are no analytics, no trackers, no third-party scripts and no advertising. The only cookie is the parent sign-in cookie. Read-aloud uses the phone's own built-in voice.
privacy.phone: Practice is saved on the phone first, so it works offline, then copied to our server. Unlinking a phone clears its copy the next time it connects.
privacy.where: On Cloudflare (Workers and a D1 database in Western Europe), which hosts the app. If password-reset email is turned on, your email address is passed to the email service only to send that message.
privacy.delete: Remove one child under that child's Settings, or everything with “Delete my account” at the bottom of the parent area. Deletion is immediate and permanent.
privacy.contact: Ask the person who gave you your invite code.
